newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GUILDER RATES STAGNATE IN BECALMED TRADE.
newsitem.headline: GUILDER RATES STAGNATE IN BECALMED TRADE.

text.p: Guilder rates held largely steady in becalmed trade on Wednesday as dealers awaited fresh market impetus.
Overnight guilders were quoting at an unchanged 3.06/12 percent bid/offer, but dealers said most deals were being done at 3.06 percent compared with 3.12 percent yesterday.
Trade in Dutch Treasury Certificates (DTCs) was also idle, after some limited interest on Tuesday, dealers said.
As of April 18 the finance ministry had raised 4.46 billion guilders under its DTC programme due June 30 which is currently priced at 3.10 percent.
Some 4.66 million has been raised under the December programme, currently priced at 3.18 percent.
The guilder was quoted at 112.47 per 100 marks at around 1155 GMT on Wednesday, down from its Tuesday fixing of 112.45.
